name: Olympic Cards Limited
summary: Olympic Cards Limited is a company primarily engaged in the production of various paper and board-based items. Its diverse product range, offered under the "Olympic" brand name, includes stationery essentials like greeting cards, office envelopes, cloth-lined covers, student notebooks, and a variety of files. Beyond these, the firm also handles the manufacturing and distribution of wedding cards, letterheads, business cards, calendars, and account books, alongside trading in printing inks. This enterprise was founded on November 1, 1962, and its main operational base is situated in Chennai, India.
